new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach result was piped directly into ConvertTo-Json and the parser rejected the empty pipe element.
new_failures.recovery: Materialized the foreach result first and then piped the bounded array.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell loop output before any downstream pipeline.

new_failures.failed_witness: A compact PowerShell object-building wrapper was malformed and stopped with a missing-closing-brace parser error.
new_failures.recovery: Used an explicit loop and accumulated typed objects before serialization.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer short attributable scalar probes over dense inline PowerShell object expressions.

new_failures.failed_witness: A grouped read of lifecycle skills exceeded the visible result bound before every selected skill was attributable through EOF.
new_failures.recovery: Reread each missing skill and directly required schema in bounded complete chunks.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Separate authority and lifecycle skill reads before combining summaries.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined authorization and roster-state display truncated before every current record was visible.
new_failures.recovery: Read both JSON records in numbered bounded chunks through EOF and preserved newer live authority precedence.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Project current state by bounded fields or numbered chunks instead of emitting entire nested records.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined source Git and canonical-receipt wrapper returned no attributable payload.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered with separate scalar head branch ancestry divergence equality and receipt probes without replaying inherited validation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep source topology remote equality and receipt checks independently attributable.

new_failures.failed_witness: The worktree-add wrapper crossed its reporting window and returned no final exit code after announcing preparation.
new_failures.recovery: Audited the filesystem Gitfile branch and head, proving the exact intended worktree already existed, and did not retry mutation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: After any mutating Git timeout or ambiguous wrapper state inspect persisted state before retry.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined new-worktree status and sparse projection emitted no attributable output.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered with isolated scalar head and branch probes before further mutation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use one scalar Git fact per probe in newly materialized sparse worktrees.

new_failures.failed_witness: A later template-size inventory repeated the direct-foreach-pipeline parser fault.
new_failures.recovery: Reapplied the materialization rule and captured the complete bounded file metrics.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Treat recurrence as a new retained witness and require the materialization guard in future wrappers.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first combined source-manifest display truncated before every manifest entry was attributable.
new_failures.recovery: Replayed all four immutable manifests directly from exact Git blobs in one bounded script: 214 entries and zero mismatches.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use exact Git-blob replay rather than large human-readable manifest projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first x1 builder wrapper crossed its reporting window while the source-bounded novelty audit was still live and later completed without a captured status or phase artifacts.
new_failures.recovery: Audited the live process and zero partial artifacts, waited for that exact process, and then invoked only a diagnostic form of the first novelty dependency.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Give long Git-object novelty audits an attributable session handle and never duplicate a still-live builder.

new_failures.failed_witness: The retained first novelty diagnostic quarantined eleven titles, including two exact inherited collisions, and earned zero novelty credit.
new_failures.recovery: Rewrote only the eleven quarantined titles with lighthouse-specific obligations before rerunning the failed novelty dependency.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Freeze proposal titles only after the exact-source neighbour audit returns no exact collision and every score is below threshold.

new_failures.failed_witness: The fresh no-checkout sparse worktree had not materialized its inherited index, so a pre-stage status displayed the inherited tree as mass staged deletions.
new_failures.recovery: Stopped before staging, ran the exact-head sparse read-tree materialization once, and proved zero deleted, staged, or modified inherited paths with only Sylven-owned additions remaining.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: After no-checkout worktree creation materialize the exact inherited index under sparse patterns before any owner generation or staging.
